description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of narrative media framing across years 2017, 2018, and 2019. The chart contains three slices, each representing a year. A blue slice, labeled “2019”, occupies the largest proportion of the chart, with a value of 46. An orange slice, labeled “2018”, takes up approximately 33% of the chart, with a numerical value of 33 also displayed. Finally, a green slice, labeled “2017”, represents 21% of the chart, with a numerical value of 21 also displayed. Percentage labels are present inside the orange and green slices, and numerical values are present inside the blue slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest and decreasing in size. A legend is not present, but each slice is directly labeled with the year it represents.
